articles.summary: Montreal, Wednesday, May 13, 2026 – Gildan Activewear Inc. (GIL: TSX and NYSE) (“Gildan” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce the publication of its 22nd Sustainability Report¹, highlighting progress under its Next Generation Sustainability strategy² and ongoing efforts to create long-term value.
articles.title: Gildan Announces the Publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Continued Progress Towards Key Social and Environmental Targets (1)

articles.summary: Montreal, Quebec, Friday, May 1, 2026 – Gildan Activewear Inc. (GIL: TSX and NYSE) (“Gildan” or the “Company”) today announced that the nine nominees proposed as directors in its management proxy circular dated March 17, 2026 were elected as directors of the Company by a majority of the votes cast by the shareholders or represented by proxy at its hybrid annual meeting of shareholders held on April 30, 2026 in Montreal.
articles.title: Gildan Activewear Reports on Shareholders’ Voting Results
